name: Navidrome
tagline: Self-hosted music streaming server compatible with Subsonic clients.
description: Navidrome is a modern, lightweight music server and streamer that gives you access to your own music collection from any browser or Subsonic-compatible app.
postInstall: Open it and create the administrator account: the first account created is the administrator.
Put your music in the Music library folder; Navidrome scans it on its own.
